one_sentence_story: Keeping a five-day swap window makes you like your own chosen photo less than being locked into a final pick, because open escape hatches keep your brain's conflict alarm firing instead of letting its satisfaction builder go to work.
so_what_for_you: Save return policies for broken items, and lock in everyday subjective choices fast so your prefrontal cortex can make you love what you picked.
